greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. Grab a coffee, it's a big news day and your brief is ready.

lead.headline: Gunman kills six in Krakow's Main Market Square
lead.summary: A gunman fired at random from a car in Krakow's main square on Saturday, killing six people and wounding about 15. Poland's interior minister said the attacker appeared drawn to far-right ideologies, and the city has declared a period of mourning.

stories.headline: Riddled basins may set hard limits on predicting deep learning
stories.summary: Published in Nature Machine Intelligence, the paper argues that training outcomes can be fundamentally unpredictable because starting points leading to different solutions sit arbitrarily close together in a fractal pattern. It is drawing attention as it began as a widely shared preprint and now has Sydney press coverage.

stories.headline: An AI-native lab that runs biomolecular experiments on its own
stories.summary: A Nature paper describes a system where LLM-powered agents coordinate more than 20 instrument types across over 11,000 experimental steps, including optimising enzymatic DNA synthesis. It is getting attention as an early end-to-end example of autonomous lab science.

stories.headline: Nvidia reportedly tightens overseas chip rentals to Chinese customers
stories.summary: Reports say cloud partners must now reserve at least 51 percent of their Nvidia-based services for non-Chinese clients. The item is part of a busy day of AI news including policy and product launches.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO faces scrutiny over reported ties to a suspected Chinese spy
stories.summary: Axios reports growing congressional pressure on Jensen Huang after a New York Times report tied a Megaspeed executive to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia and Beijing dispute the characterisation.

stories.headline: Man arrested after delivery rider stabbed to death in the CBD
stories.summary: Police say a delivery rider died and another was wounded after they allegedly confronted a man tampering with their bikes. A 51-year-old Footscray man was arrested.

stories.headline: Construction corruption royal commission begins public hearings
stories.summary: Victoria's royal commission into alleged corruption on major construction projects is holding its first block of public hearings in Melbourne. It is due to report to the government by next year.

stories.headline: Body found in Alpine region believed to be missing Warrnambool man
stories.summary: Police believe a man found dead in Victoria's Alpine region is a 76-year-old from Warrnambool who had disappeared in the area. A Melbourne man was also charged over illicit tobacco.

stories.headline: COP31 opens in Antalya with an electrification push
stories.summary: The summit's Turkish presidency is pushing a goal of 35 percent of final energy from electricity by 2035, as the 1.5C target looks harder to hold. Australia is co-leading negotiations.

stories.headline: Beijing rejects claims about Nvidia's chief and a Chinese spy
stories.summary: China called the New York Times-sourced allegations groundless speculation, while US lawmakers increase scrutiny of the Nvidia boss.

thought: The best way to predict the future is to build it, one small step at a time.
